resources.string: Enter this PIN starting with the digit %1$d, using at least %2$d whole digits, 0 to 9 only. No decimal point, operators, or functions. Then press and hold =. You will enter the whole PIN again afterwards to confirm it.
This PIN needs at least %1$d digits. Enter %1$d or more whole digits, 0 to 9, starting with %2$d, then press and hold =.
This PIN must start with the digit %1$d. Each role uses its own first digit, so no two PINs can overlap. Enter it starting with %1$d, then press and hold =.
Enter the same digits as your first entry (at least %1$d), then the operators. Do not press =.
